title: 第371章 三言两语震慑大祭司
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

安澜在品味着刘盈这一番话。

刘盈也发现安澜似乎很喜欢自己吹牛逼的样子。

可是，刘盈还是打算找个机会，和臧儿说清楚，自己究竟是什么样的人。

他希望臧儿在自己面前表现出来真性情的一面。

至于别的人面前，臧儿该怎么伪装，那就怎么伪装。

简单来说，臧儿自己开心就好。

刘盈正准备驱马走下山坡，去加入臧儿和三个牧羊女的谈话之中的时候，谷蠡单于部落的大祭司就已经火急火燎的赶了过来。

刘盈看着大祭司手里那奇怪的节杖，表情有些异样起来。

大祭司这个时候正在低着头，向着刘盈躬身行礼。

刘盈道：“无需多礼，寡人传话你过来，你也大致上应该知道是为了什么吧？”

“臣自然知晓。”大祭司笑道：“殿下应该是想要询问，关于那些孤儿寡母的事情？”

“既然知道，那想必你也想好了一套说辞了？”

刘盈笑了笑，又聪明又老实的人，谁能不爱？

大祭司躬身笑道：“我过来这边，虽然是为了给单于出谋，让他一切都顺从殿下，但是本质上，其实还是为了能够得到殿下的召见。”

刘盈露出讶色来：“这么说，你自己很想见我？”

大祭司非常大胆地说道：“不是很想，而是非常想！”

“哈哈哈……”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

An Lan was savoring Liu Ying's words.

Liu Ying also found that An Lan seemed to like her bragging.

However, Liu Ying still planned to find an opportunity to tell Zang Er clearly what kind of person she was.

He hoped that Zang'er would show his true nature in front of him.

As for how Zang Er should disguise himself in front of other people, that's how he should disguise himself.

To put it simply, Zang'er just wants to be happy.

When Liu Ying was about to drive her horse down the hillside to join the conversation between Zang'er and the three shepherdess, the high priest of the Guli Shanyu tribe had already rushed over in a hurry.

Liu Ying looked at the strange scepter in the high priest's hand with a strange expression.

The high priest was lowering his head at this time and bowing to Liu Ying.

Liu Ying said: "No need to be polite, I sent a message for you to come over. You should know roughly what it is for, right?"

"Of course I know." The high priest smiled and said: "Your Highness probably wants to ask about those orphans and widows?"

"Now that you know it, you must have thought of a way to say it?"

Liu Ying smiled, who could not love such a smart and honest person?

The high priest bowed and said with a smile: "Although I came here to advise Shanyu and make him obey His Highness in everything, in essence, it is to get His Highness's summons."

Liu Ying looked surprised: "So, you really want to see me?"

The high priest said very boldly: "It's not that I want it very much, but I want it very much!"

"Hahaha..."
